name: Border Overload
detailed_description:
"Border Overload" is an exciting rogue-lite strategy RPG game. In a scientific research space station that had to execute a self destruct program due to an experimental accident, players as station engineers need to make good use of the limited space in their backpacks, match different effects of items to defeat enemies blocking the way, and finally take the elevator to the location of the escape platform to save their lives. In this game, you will experience unique gameplay and challenges, bringing endless fun.

Game features:

Random room map:

Each entry is a brand new experience, collecting various items obtained in the level, eliminating or avoiding enemies in the maze like rooms.

Character backpacks and a variety of items

The character played by the player can carry a variety of items, which can be arranged in an appropriate way in the backpack to bring greater advantages when fighting against enemies. Please try different combinations as you wish, but also remember to pay attention to the clock ticking.

Special circuits and synthesis mechanisms

Players may receive some special "circuit modules" that can be combined to obtain more powerful items when they are placed in a backpack and achieve specific combinations.

Limited time

The self destruct program of the space station has been activated, and there is not much time left for players to escape, so it is best not to excessively entangle with enemies.
